component_findings.abstraction_ceremony: Recertified level 4 under the current criterion: Reusable abstractions such as types, interfaces/traits/generics or equivalent mechanisms can be declared and consumed without excessive scaffolding. Evidence basis: No cross-language byte/line-count comparison table was produced in this shard (assigned languages = Kotlin only); comparison is against idiomatic-best-practice expectation for the same frozen algorithm as required by language_quality.md fairness rules, not against a fabricated multi-language corpus. | Qualitative + structural analysis of sampled Kotlin micro-benchmark and adversarial programs under template/programs/kotlin/{micro,adversarial}. metric.code_efficiency_conciseness.limitations: Comparison-language reprojection requires the preserved paid source evidence plus the historical program/workload/toolchain inputs to match the current shard; mismatches remain misses.
metric.code_efficiency_conciseness.selection_rule: Judge intrinsic mandatory ceremony for the same kinds of ordinary programs. Do not reuse raw LOC/bytes/tokens as the score and do not reward external libraries.

component_findings.consistency_regular_forms: Recertified level 3 under the current criterion: Similar concepts use regular forms with few special-case spellings or context-dependent surface rules.
